verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo bar, but the hierarchy is broken. The 'Reserve a Case' button and 'Ships late June' have shrunk to an unreadable size, the body copy is now bigger than the CTA, the legal text is about as big as the CTA, the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow is gone and the headline runs almost to the canvas edges. B has a proper CTA and keeps the eyebrow, but the brand bar is cropped so the SOLSTICE wordmark is lost, the orange divider runs through 'our seaside' in the body copy, 'Ships late June' is as large as the CTA, and the whole stack is cramped with no margins.
